signup.subtitle: Create your account to save the plan and activate your 7-day free trial.

login.subtitle: Access your plan and continue where you left off.

reset.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
reset.success: We sent a recovery link to your email.

validation.passwordMinimum: The password must have at least {{min}} characters.
validation.linkPasswordRequired: Enter your password to link the account.

linking.title: Account already exists
linking.passwordMessage: The email {{email}} already uses email/password. Enter your password to link {{attemptedProvider}}.
linking.providerMessage: The email {{email}} already uses {{existingProvider}}. Sign in with {{existingProvider}} to link {{attemptedProvider}}.
linking.unknownMethodMessage: This email is already used by another sign-in method. Sign in with the original method to continue.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.genericWithCode: Something went wrong ({{code}}). Check your Firebase/Google configuration.
errors.googleConfig: Google Sign-In is configured incorrectly. Rebuild the app after checking the OAuth client, URL scheme, and SHA-1.
errors.appNotAuthorized: This app isn't authorized in Firebase. Check the bundle/package and GoogleService files.
errors.invalidApiKey: The Firebase API key is invalid. Check the .env file.
errors.weakPassword: The password must have at least 6 characters.
errors.userNotFound: We couldn't find an account with this email.
errors.invalidCredential: Invalid credential. If you used Google, check the Firebase OAuth client IDs.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.networkFailed: Connection failed. Check your internet connection.
errors.operationNotAllowed: This sign-in method isn't enabled in Firebase Auth.
errors.accountExists: This email is already registered with another sign-in method.
errors.credentialInUse: This account is already linked to another user.
errors.providerLinked: This provider is already linked to your account.
errors.permissionDenied: The login was created, but Firestore blocked profile creation. Check the deployed rules.
errors.unavailable: Firestore is currently unavailable. Try again.
